title: A new visual world for Dóra Yoga
question: Bolder directions, as requested: three complete visual systems translated into Dóra’s yoga, sound and community practice.

options.label: The Frequency Field
options.lineage: One type scale, a precise rail, line-form states
options.thesis: Sound made visible: a charcoal field, one precise navigation rail, and documentary images in graphite.
options.viewport: A full-height yoga photograph sits above an off-centre rail; classes and sound sessions open as large plates from that line.
options.risk: A beautiful but deliberately technical visual language; the teacher and real photographs must make it welcoming.
options.case: The real photograph and clear class action keep the yoga offer immediate.

options.label: The Movement Manifesto
options.lineage: Condensed type, photographic montage, one strong diagonal
options.thesis: A bold contemporary manifesto for movement: large type, decisive red forms and real yoga photography.
options.viewport: Black condensed lettering and a sunlit yoga photograph cut across a cream field; a red directional form leads directly to the class calendar.
options.risk: The energetic graphic language is an intentional departure from conventional gentle wellness branding.
options.case: The real photograph and clear class action keep the yoga offer immediate.

options.label: The Afterglow Garden
options.lineage: Thin luminous type, branching paths, proximity light
options.thesis: An immersive evening garden for breath, sound and inner exploration, with living light responding to your attention.
options.viewport: A dark atmospheric light field surrounds a real photograph of Dóra; bright, quiet lettering leads to yoga, sound and community paths.
options.risk: The immersive night atmosphere suits the sound and circle work more naturally than daytime yoga.
options.case: The real photograph and clear class action keep the yoga offer immediate.

options.label: The Class Departure Board
options.thesis: Every class becomes a destination on a live departure board.
options.viewport: A full-screen class and retreat departure board.
options.case: The schedule is clear, but a transport board obscures the teacher and personal nature of the practice.
options.kept: Keep schedules rigorously aligned and readable.

options.label: The Practice Label
options.thesis: Black, white and safety-orange literal labels turn every practice into a graphic object.
options.viewport: Large quoted practice labels and stark monochrome photographs.
options.risk: The industrial mood conflicts with the intimacy of private experiences.
options.case: It identifies movement clearly but makes the circle and sound work feel like merchandise.

options.label: The Movement Broadcast
options.thesis: A high-contrast red broadcast sequence introduces each practice.
options.viewport: Full-screen title, location, and instruction sequence.
options.case: The alert grammar distracts from an unhurried personal practice.

canonCard.label: The familiar wellness studio
canonCard.thesis: A conventional, carefully executed yoga website.
canonCard.viewport: A centered introduction over a wide photograph, followed by service cards and a schedule.
canonCard.risk: Comfortable and clear, but less distinctive from nearby studios.
